rationale: The measured 1.3.6-rc1 reference is the first baseline validated by the current output-signature and clean-machine dependency gates. Tagged 1.3.2-1.3.5 Full installers omitted load-bearing AVIF and JPEG XL writer files and are not valid no-regression baselines. Keep later releases within 128 KiB compressed and 256 KiB for each raw payload unless an explicit reviewed policy change records why. Policy change (reviewed 2026-08-01, dev @ 1.4.2): the Lepton (.lep) decode tier added in 1.4.1 grew the measured raw Rust payload (sagethumbs2k.dll + SageThumbs2K.exe + st2k.exe, same-name check in check-release-size.ps1) from 22,216,192 to 22,528,000 bytes — 49,664 bytes over the old ceiling; the payload is rebuilt from scratch for 1.4.2 and re-measured at 22,528,000, which is now the reference (allowance unchanged at 256 KiB).
